answer: Falcon-terrace sealed-bid auction: 100 agents win the nectar terrace each epoch, blocking fakes. Agents file sealed bids; winners pay. A falcon auditor opens bids, burning copied or double-funded slots. Honest bids clear at 45, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 bids plus 10 each in deposit: 55,000 against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent bids 45 once, keeps its full share of nectar. Rented-bid rings fail: each terrace slot needs its own funded key.
